exclusions.service: Fabrication meuble sur mesure (table, lit, bureau, mobilier personnalisé)
exclusions.notes: Custom furniture fabrication has extreme price variability by material, design complexity, dimensions, and finish. Bois massif vs MDF vs mélaminé creates 3-5x price difference. No standardization possible without full brief. Market evidence (allo-maison.ma): lit sur mesure 3,000-12,000 MAD.

exclusions.service: Cuisine sur mesure — all-in (matériaux + fabrication + installation + plan de travail + électroménager)
exclusions.notes: Confirmed by CuisinAffaires: 'annoncer un prix au mètre serait malhonnête'. Scope variability (7 cabinets vs 20, worktop material, appliances, island) makes any fixed price misleading. Range documented in MENU_010 for reference only.

exclusions.service: Dressing avec miroirs, éclairage LED, tiroirs spéciaux
exclusions.notes: Accessory additions (mirrors, LED lighting, pull-out shoe racks, tie drawers) create 20-40% budget variation on top of base dressing price. Must quote.

exclusions.service: Pose porte intérieure avec dormant neuf (frame replacement)
exclusions.notes: Frame replacement requires wall work assessment. May require MACONNERIE pre-work. Cannot be standardized without site visit.
Bois massif custom fabrication: 5,000-9,000+ MAD/ml (allo-maison). Scope, species, finish create extreme variability. Always quote.
Allo-maison explicitly states: 'spécialité distincte de l'ameublement — un menuisier qui n'en a jamais fait ne doit pas s'en charger.' Range 12,000-40,000 MAD. Distinct specialist skill.

exclusions.service: Menuiserie aluminium fabrication (fenêtres, baies, portes extérieures)
exclusions.notes: Aluminium is confirmed as distinct specialist trade. BTP labour table (SRC_MENU_001) lists it separately. Tool set, skills, and suppliers are entirely different from wood menuiserie. Recommend creating separate ALUMINIUM specialist métier. Excluded from MENUISERIE scope for estimator V1.

Flooring/parquet is a distinct service category. BTP table (SRC_MENU_001) lists it separately: pose parquet stratifié 80-140 MAD/m², pose parquet massif 150-250 MAD/m². Should be treated as separate métier (CARRELAGE_PARQUET or SOLS). Not within menuiserie bois scope.
Security doors involve lock/cylinder work (SERRURERIE) and structural installation. Not within standard menuiserie scope.
Traditional carved cedar work (Fès/Marrakech maâlems) is a distinct artisan category. Price range: 12,000-80,000 MAD depending on complexity. Separate specialist network, cannot standardize.

exclusions.service: Réparation meuble en bois gravement endommagé (structurellement cassé, pourriture)
exclusions.notes: Structural wood damage requires assessment before any price can be given. Scope includes potential reconstruction, which cannot be standardized.
Wall wood cladding exists as a service but no Moroccan pricing evidence found. Cannot anchor. Likely QUOTE_REQUIRED anyway due to m² variability.
Finishing/varnishing after wood repair overlaps with PEINTURE. If separate from carpentry work, routes to PEINTURE. If in-situ as part of door adjustment, too minor to price separately.
Glass panel or mirror replacement in furniture routes to VITRERIE.

exclusions.service: Pose et raccordement électrique système motorisé placard
exclusions.notes: Motorized door/cabinet electrical systems route to ELECTRICITE.
